chief_complaint: Shortness of breath and chest tightness, especially with exertion.
doctor_notes: Patient presents with symptoms suggestive of stable angina. History of hypertension and type 2 diabetes, poorly controlled based on recent labs.  Discussed lifestyle modifications, medication adherence, and importance of regular exercise within limits. Advised to use nitroglycerin as prescribed. Plan for stress test within 2 weeks.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Hello Eleanor, what brings you in today?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: I've been feeling quite breathless lately, doctor, especially when I walk up stairs or do chores. And sometimes I get this tightness in my chest.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I see. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: It's been getting worse over the past few weeks, maybe a month.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: And have you noticed if anything makes the chest tightness better or worse?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Resting helps a little, and sometimes a deep breath. But it's worrying me.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I understand. We'll get to the bottom of this. Your blood pressure is a bit elevated today, and your recent lab results show your blood sugar and cholesterol are also higher than we'd like. These are important factors to consider with your symptoms.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: I know, I've been trying to be good with my diet, but it's hard. And remembering all my medications...

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: We'll review your medications and make sure you're taking them correctly. I'm also prescribing some nitroglycerin for you to keep on hand in case of severe chest pain.  We'll also schedule you for a stress test to get a clearer picture of your heart's function.  In the meantime, please use your nitroglycerin as directed and call us if symptoms worsen significantly or don't improve with rest.

follow_up_actions: Monitor blood pressure and blood glucose at home.
